alerts.text: Agent SDK usage no longer shares your plan limits
alerts.dashboardText: Starting Jun 15, programmatic usage — Agent SDK, claude -p, GitHub Actions, and third-party apps — draws from a new separate monthly credit: $20 on Pro, $100 on Max 5×, $200 on Max 20×. Interactive Claude Code sessions are unaffected. Tap to learn more.
High burn hours: {startHour}–{endHour} on week days. burns through 5-hour usage limits faster during weekday peak hours.
Per a US government export-control directive, Anthropic has suspended access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all users. All other Claude models remain available. Tap to read Anthropic's statement.

alerts.text: Claude Fable 5 on Pro & Max ends tomorrow
alerts.dashboardText: Last chance — Claude Fable 5's limited-time availability on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans ends tomorrow, June 22.

alerts.text: Claude Fable 5 — on Pro & Max for a limited time
alerts.dashboardText: Claude Fable 5 is here — state-of-the-art across coding, knowledge work, and research. Available to try on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans for a limited time, through June 22.
Claude Opus 4.8 is here — sharper coding, better judgment, and more reliable agentic work, at the same price. Tap to read more.
Big upgrade: Claude Code 5-hour limits just doubled across paid plans, and peak-hour caps are gone for Pro and Max.
